candidates.title: MoE load-balancing loss adds no gradient under reentrant gradient checkpointing
candidates.snippet: Router logits are collected with forward hooks. A reentrant checkpoint runs each layer's first forward under `no_grad`, so those logits carry no graph: `router_aux_loss_coef * aux_loss` shows up in the logged loss but adds nothing to backward. The recompute does build a graph, but nothing collects its logits.
